lines.text: Many learners say: I use a hat in the sun.
Better: I wear a hat in the sun.

data.wrong: I use a hat in the sun.
data.right: I wear a hat in the sun.

native.tip: Kita bilang “memakai topi”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai wear untuk baju, topi, dan kacamata.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I use a hat in the sun.” 😅 Untuk topi dan baju, pakai wear: “I wear a hat in the sun.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “wears”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang pakaian yang kamu pakai hari ini dengan wear. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “memakai topi”, but English uses wear for clothes, hats, and glasses.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I use a hat in the sun.” 😅 For hats and clothes, use wear: “I wear a hat in the sun.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
